observations: Photo 0 and 1: close-up of a dark-colored electronic keyboard, full-size white/black keys, row of small buttons above keys, mesh speaker grille on right side, dim lighting makes some labels hard to read.
Photo 2: wider top-down view showing full key range, two speaker cutouts, and the word 'YAMAHA' printed in white at the bottom left edge of the body.
No visible model number (e.g. 'SX-600') is legible in any of the three photos; the brand 'YAMAHA' is the only readable text.
No power cable, adapter, or display screen is visible in any shot.
A semi-transparent watermark 'GEORGE GEORGE' overlays all three images, obscuring some control-panel text.
No photo shows the keyboard powered on, no screen lit, no audio/video evidence of sound output.

claims.claim: Working 100% perfectly, no dead key, no crackle
claims.evidence: No power-on photo or audio/video clip provided; keys appear intact in photos 0-2 but functionality cannot be judged from stills.
Only 'YAMAHA' brand text is legible in photo 2; no model number visible in any photo.
No adapter or power cable visible in any of the three photos.
No import sticker, plug type, or voltage label visible in any photo.
Keys and body look clean in available photos, but dim lighting and watermark limit full inspection of wear or cracks.

risks.risk: Exact model cannot be confirmed, which changes expected feature set and value
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the model/serial plate (usually on the back or near the power input) or the full front panel without watermark obstruction
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unidentified Yamaha portable keyboard, lowest plausible tier

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have dead keys/crackling despite claim
risks.proof: A video of the unit powering on, playing a scale across the full key range, and a brief audio clip through the speaker

risks.risk: Adapter may not actually be included or may be wrong voltage/plug for Nigeria
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter next to the keyboard showing plug type and voltage rating

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage (cracks, broken buttons, water damage) hidden by dark photos and watermark
risks.proof: Additional well-lit photos from multiple angles, including the back panel and underside, without watermark overlay

risks.risk: Display screen condition unknown (no screen visible in any photo)
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the screen powered on, if the model has one

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial number plate on the back or bottom of the keyboard
Video of the keyboard powering on and being played across all keys with audible sound
Photo of the adapter showing plug type and voltage rating
Additional well-lit photos of the full body, back panel, and any screen, without watermark covering text
response.reason: The brand Yamaha is visible but the specific model that determines price is not legible in any photo, and no functional proof (power-on, sound, screen) or adapter photo is provided, so even a worst-case price cannot be anchored without knowing the model.
